reviews.author: Judi Whittington
reviews.text: Working with Roger and his company Southeast Tree & Stump Removal Service was an amazing experience. The teams skill at working the chainsaw from within the bucket lift had the entire neighborhood watching from their porches. The team under Rogers direction was able to remove four 80 ft dead trees. One of the trees needed to be pulled the opposite direction from where it was leaning over power lines and a house. As a team they all communicated and worked together with hand gestures and nods to drop the tree in a narrow path with required precision. All bystanders held their breath while the team worked their magic with precise target perfection. I highly recommend Southeast Tree & Stump Removal Service for everyone needing tree and stump services.

reviews.author: Patricia Shankle
reviews.text: Great work by great folk. Prompt, good communication, fast, efficient and excellence. We are pleased with the way our backyard looks after they removed trees and tackled a huge job of clearing the property. If you want it done right, call Roger & Amy. They are the best.

reviews.author: Annette Reed
reviews.text: Was extremely please. Arrived on time, did an excellent job of removing a fallen tree as well as cutting down a tree that was in danger of coming down. Were very meticulous in making sure that wood was removed and area was cleaned of any debris. Will use again if the need arises. Picture prior to removing.
